correctness.rationale: The full ordinary matching complex of \(G(8,3)\) is reconstructed from the graph definition. Exhaustive enumeration gives 11,068 matchings including the empty matching and the exact face vector. A deterministic face-poset matching is checked globally acyclic over 11,067 simplices and 53,256 covers. Its Morse CW model has critical profile \((1,10,6)\) in dimensions \((0,4,5)\); the signed Morse boundary has Smith invariants \((1,1)\). Since \(\pi_4(\bigvee^{10}S^4)\cong\mathbb{Z}^{10}\), the degree matrix determines the attaching maps, and Smith reduction yields \(\bigvee^8S^4\vee\bigvee^4S^5\). Direct mod-2 homology independently gives Betti vector \((1,0,0,0,8,4,0,0)\).

value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is the standard 16-vertex cubic symmetric generalized Petersen graph, so the object is canonical rather than an arbitrary finite slice. Its ordinary matching complex is a core topological graph complex, and the exact result exhibits a mixed-dimensional wedge \(\bigvee^8S^4\vee\bigvee^4S^5\) in a natural symmetric example. This gives a reproducible benchmark beyond the restricted graph families whose matching-complex homotopy types are presently explicit.
